title: Latroforce
metaTitle: Latroforce Rebrand Proposal — Case Study | Santi Universe
description: A proposed Latroforce rebrand for its management services, with identity studies and concept mockups for cleaning teams, equipment, waste management and access points.
intro: A proposed identity for a business focused on building better businesses — bringing Latroforce’s management services together through a refined emblem, a flexible pattern system and practical brand applications.

hero.alt: Latroforce stationery concept with navy folder, notebook, letterhead and business cards
hero.caption: Stationery application · Concept mockup

chapters.label: The proposal
heading: Familiar energy.
A lighter expression.
text: Latroforce partners with businesses to provide management services across cleaning personnel, cleaning equipment and machines, safe working and operational procedures, waste management, gate and access management, and the manning of access points.

The proposal explores a new visual direction for Latroforce while retaining its name and the line “Efficiency Agility Innovation”. A fine-line running figure replaces the heavier illustrated emblem shown at the start of the proposal.
The following designs are presented as proposal work. They show the direction of the identity, rather than a confirmed launch or completed rollout.

chapters.label: The identity
heading: One mark.
Room to move.
text: The running figure carries the sense of motion into a more open, linear mark. The proposal pairs it with the Latroforce wordmark and explores horizontal, stacked and emblem-only arrangements.
These variations give the identity options for wide layouts, compact spaces and profile images, while keeping the same visual character.

chapters.label: Pattern language
heading: Movement,
made graphic.
text: Looping bands extend the motion of the emblem into a wider graphic language. The proposal explores outlined ribbons, cropped curves and repeating motifs.
Deep navy, warm sand and white carry through the supplied presentation designs. Large patterned corners frame the content, while faint outlines provide a quieter background.

chapters.label: Presentations
heading: A system for
the next conversation.
text: The supplied presentation templates bring the identity into use: landscape-led opening slides, broad white content areas and the emblem placed in the corners.
The layouts range from bold photographic compositions to restrained frames, giving the proposed identity variety across a deck.

chapters.label: Service applications
heading: One identity.
Across every service.
text: Four concept mockups explore how the proposed identity could appear in the places Latroforce works: on cleaning-team uniforms, cleaning equipment, waste-management stations and a staffed access point.

The uniform and equipment concepts bring the branding into day-to-day cleaning operations. Clearly labelled waste bins and a visitor check-in point extend it into waste management, gate management and staffed access services. Safe working and operational procedures sit alongside these services in Latroforce’s offering.
chapters.note: The service and stationery mockups were created with AI to illustrate the proposed identity. They do not document actual staff, assets or installations.

chapters.label: In context
heading: From the screen
to the desk.
text: A stationery concept explores how the proposed mark and ribbon language could extend to letterhead, cards, a folder and a notebook. The supplied identity and presentation artwork provide the visual reference.
chapters.note: The stationery image illustrates a possible application of the proposed identity, not produced stationery or a completed rollout. The logo studies and presentation layouts come from the supplied proposal files.
